violation_type.title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk (26 TAC §747.701(5))
violation_type.short_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Situations Placing Children at Risk
violation_type.typical_finding: An Incident report was not completed regarding for an incident that placed a child at risk when the child exited the facility without being supervised.

finding_variants.text: An Incident report was not completed regarding for an incident that placed a child at risk when the child exited the facility without being supervised.
During the investigation, it was found that an incident report was not created for a situation that occurred that placed a child at risk.
Based upon the information obtained, the operation did not complete an incident report documenting a situation that put a child at risk.
